title: Caravan Ledger
description: Instrument-stream run against a local creator preview of the workspace copy, per the games/smoke.json pattern: `npx @dcl/sdk-commands start --no-browser --port 8023` in the scene dir, `decentra-bevy --server http://127.0.0.1:8023 --mcp --mcp-port 8133`. The realm below is that url because it is what this explorer reports as its realm (measured 2026-08-22, current bevy build; the LocalPreview name smoke.json documents is what an older build reported) - the wrong-world gate then refuses any client that is not in this exact preview. The port is pinned per scene by scripts/foundry-bench-scenes.sh. The scene self-plays: the auto-pilot simSystem plans and drives trips from boot with no input. At caravan speed 2 map-units/s over the 6-post map the first delivery lands ~30 s in, so the 90 s wait covers config, route choice, fuel accounting, price observation, a load and a delivery; the session summary line only appears every 5 trips and is deliberately not a check here - it can fall outside the wait on slow routes, and a check that fails on pacing rather than the game would be noise.

steps.label: center post P4, overlooking the network
the auto-pilot completes its first trips; the log ring is drained throughout

checks.why: a scene that throws on load looks fine in a screenshot and is broken
an async failure the scene swallowed still leaves state half-applied
every design number the GDD commits to is emitted at startup (GDD §9)
the pilot's route choice is on the record per trip, with the true argmax beside it
interview #1: deterministic fuel cost per map-unit, accounted per leg and refuel
arrival refreshes the last-known price and records the observation error
a buy at the pickup post: units, cost and the target price it pushed
a sell at the delivery post - the core loop closed at least once (GDD §2)
